rationale: Medical and finance require trust, clarity, and precision. A light theme with deep teal (satisfying the user's color request) paired with organic off-whites creates a calming yet authoritative financial dashboard. We avoid harsh generic cyan to maintain an elegant, 'E1' anti-AI aesthetic.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6

components.buttons: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-200 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none
components.inputs: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
components.table_headers: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-medium py-3 px-4 uppercase text-xs tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200
components.badges: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors

login_background.description: Abstract light teal geometric background for the login screen to provide a sophisticated entry point.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all standard icons (Eye, LayoutDashboard, Receipt, AlertCircle, Users, LogOut, Wallet, TrendingUp). No need to install additional libraries.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup JWT authentication. Create a robust protected route wrapper that checks for roles (Superadmin, Admin, Usuario). Use the media.login_background image on the login page split screen.
2. Implement a unified layout consisting of a left Sidebar navigation and a top Header with user profile and logout.
3. Use Shadcn UI components for Tables, Selects, Dialogs, and Forms. Customize their colors to match the teal palette described.
4. For the Dashboard: Implement a 4-column grid. Place key metric cards at the top (Total Expenses GTQ, Pending Payments).
5. Expiration Alerts: Below the top metrics, create two distinct panels/lists exclusively for 'Vencimientos a 30 días' and 'Vencimientos a 60 días'. Use amber/rose colors for these warnings.

6. Expense Module: Create a view with a Data Table to list all expenses. Add a dialog/form to register new expenses (Fields: Concepto, Monto GTQ, Fecha, Categoría [Gastos fijos, Pagos proveedores, Gastos variables], Estado [Pagado, Pendiente]).
7. Financial Charts: Use Recharts to show monthly expenses by category. Ensure colors match the `chart_palette` array.
8. User Management: Simple view to add users and assign roles if Superadmin.
9. CRITICAL TESTING REQUIREMENT: Ensure every key interactive element has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="expense-row-1"`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over the teal primary color is pure white (#FFFFFF).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500`.
